## Summary

**PR #461**: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/461 — "RES-02/GAP-NARROW-MONITOR-ESCALATION Phase 1: wire 5 more Tier-1 monitors"

**What was built**: Expanded the Narrow Monitor Agent mechanism from 2 wired event types (`APPROVAL_GRANTED`/`APPROVAL_REJECTED`) to 11 of ~30, via a new shared `rule-engine-monitor.ts` executor (factors out `approval-decision-monitor.ts`'s registry-lookup/validate/escalate/log pattern for reuse) plus 5 new monitors wired at real call sites:
- Workflow completion timeliness (`approval-workflow-service.ts`)
- Task completion timeliness (`task-service.ts`)
- Board meeting hold timeliness (`src/app/api/board/[id]/route.ts`)
- Meeting-intelligence generation success/failure (`veri-meeting-service.ts`)
- Webhook delivery outcome (`webhook-deliver.ts`)

Before writing code, I researched every remaining documented event-type wildcard (TASK_*, TODO_*, MEETING_*, DOCUMENT_*, etc.) via 3 parallel investigations and deliberately did **not** fabricate rules for the ~19 event types that turned out to have no real call site, no `TenantDb`/`dbUser` context at their real (cron) call site, or zero rule-discriminating power — all documented honestly in `ai-os/CONSTITUTION.yaml`'s RES-02 entry and `MASTER-TRACKER.yaml`.

**Verification**: `tsc`/`lint` clean, `bun test` 1708/1708 passing (29 new tests), all 6 local CI guardrail scripts pass.

**CI**: All required checks green (audit-check, Lint, Type Check, Build, Unit Tests, E2E Tests, and all governance/guardrail checks). Only Vercel fails, which is known-rate-limited and non-required.

**Tier**: TIER2 (diff includes `drizzle/0242_narrow_monitor_agents_phase1.sql`) — **not self-merged**, per the task's own instructions. PR is ready and waiting for Owner sign-off.
